subject: Re: POC scope re-baseline & added use case — Acme Analytics POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: POC success criteria & next steps

Thanks, Dana — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared baseline for the POC: 

1) Success criteria (what Acme will measure):
- Mean latency for 99th percentile responses <= 450ms for the document search use case (50–500 token responses)
- Semantic similarity precision >= 0.82 on your labeled eval set (50 queries)
- End-to-end throughput >= 25 qps during peak synthetic load (10k docs)

2) Scope: primary use case = semantic document search (ingest ~10k documents). Optional secondary use case (chat summarization) to be scoped separately during week 2 if time permits.

3) Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): onboarding + dataset handoff
- Week 1: ingest + baseline runs
- Week 2: tuning + evaluation vs success criteria
- Week 3: handoff & results, decision on production next steps

4) Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (POC lead), Monica (CS engineer)
- Acme: Dana (product lead) + SRE contact for infra tests

5) Next steps: please confirm acceptance of the success criteria and timeline by EOD Friday. If you want the chat summarization use case included in the initial POC scope, confirm the sample data and target metrics so we can re-baseline.

I've attached the draft SOW and the CSV template for success criteria collection. Happy to hop on a quick call to re-align.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Acme_PO_Statement_of_Work_v2.pdf, poc-success-criteria.csv
From: Dana Li <dana.li@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC success criteria & next steps

Thanks for the clear recap — this looks good overall. Quick update from our side after internal sync:

- We confirm the document search success criteria, but we want to add chat summarization as a second use case to the POC. The goal is to validate both retrieval-based QA and short-form summary generation for customer support transcripts.
- For summarization we propose the following additional success metrics: ROUGE-L >= 0.45 on a 100-sample eval, and average summary length of 30–60 words.
- We can provide a 1k transcript sample by Friday, and procurement will push a PO draft next week.

If adding summarization significantly changes effort or timeline, please flag — we may accept a 1-week extension. Also looping in procurement (procurement@acme-analytics.com) for timing.

— Dana
Head of Product, Acme Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC success criteria & next steps

Appreciate the quick reply, Dana — adding chat summarization mid-POC is doable but will require a re-baseline so we can set realistic success criteria and schedule. Proposed re-baseline approach: 

1) Scope change: add Summarization use case (1k transcripts initially). Evaluate both models for retrieval+generation and standalone summarization.

2) Updated timeline (re-baseline):
- Week 0 (now — onboarding + data handoff)
- Week 1: ingest docs + transcripts; baseline runs for both use cases
- Week 2: targeted tuning for semantic search + summarization; collect eval results
- Week 3: final validation + runbook and handoff (note: +1 week vs original)

3) Cost/effort: incremental engineering time for ingest and eval of transcripts; small increase to compute run budget. We'll provide an updated SOW and estimate.

4) Owners & asks:
- Acme: share transcript samples (anonymized) and a small labeled set for summarization eval (10–20 reference summaries)
- Redwood: Monica will take lead on ingestion and evaluation; Marissa will own coordination and SOW updates

Can we confirm acceptance of the re-baselined timeline by Tuesday EOD? Once confirmed we'll send an updated SOW and Data Transfer link.

Thanks — looping Rishi for approval on scope/price delta.

Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC scope re-baseline & added use case — Acme Analytics POC

Thanks for the heads up. Approved to proceed with the re-baseline and include chat summarization as part of this POC under the following constraints: 
- Keep the POC up to a single additional week (total +1 week).
- We absorb a portion of the increased compute cost; I'll confirm the final delta after Monica's estimate.
- Any feature work beyond evaluation (e.g., extractor integration) will be scoped out of this POC and handled as a follow-on project.

Monica — please share a short estimate (hours + compute delta) by EOD Monday so I can finalize the internal approval.

Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@acme-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Acme Analytics Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC scope re-baseline & added use case — Acme Analytics POC

Hi Dana / team — thanks for sharing the transcript sample earlier this week. Quick status and attachments: 

- Ingestion complete (1k transcripts ingested, 10k docs).
- Baseline results attached: poc-success-criteria.csv shows initial search precision = 0.79 (need tuning) and summarization ROUGE-L = 0.46 (meets target).
- Compute delta estimate: additional GPU hours ~ 18 — estimated incremental cost $1,950.

Next steps: 
- Marissa: please confirm whether Acme is OK with the +1 week timeline and the compute delta (Rishi offered to absorb part; we need final confirmation from procurement).
- Dana: if you confirm acceptance, we'll update the SOW and share a signed DocuSign link.

Attached: poc-success-criteria.csv, Acme_PO_Statement_of_Work_v2.pdf

Regards,
Monica
Customer Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
